name: infisical
description: Infisical (self-hosted secrets manager): uses DB auto-detection for a transaction-consistent pg_dump of the Infisical DB as a clean, portable restore path. The raw Postgres volume 'pg_data' is replaced by the logical dump (not tarred); the regenerable Redis cache/queue 'redis_data' is excluded via pattern. No Supabase flavor needed (a single DB, no cluster roles - the fresh postgres container recreates the app role from the .env). IMPORTANT - RESTORE: Infisical encrypts the secrets in Postgres with ENCRYPTION_KEY (or ROOT_ENCRYPTION_KEY) and AUTH_SECRET from the '.env'. This '.env' lives in the stack folder and is part of the backup - it MUST be identical on restore, otherwise the secrets cannot be decrypted. This applies to the internal software encryption; an external KMS/HSM (AWS/GCP) lies outside the backup and must be backed up separately. Check that POSTGRES_DB matches the DB from DB_CONNECTION_URI; if you use AUDIT_LOGS_DB_CONNECTION_URI on a separate DB, back that up as well. Volume named differently? Adjust the 'redis_data' exclude.
